name: Hands-free talk
doc: Hands-free voice conversation, a modality of the shared bar in every view: one tap opens the mic; the page detects the end of each turn, the speech is transcribed fast on the server and sent to the conversation the bar talks to as a normal voice message, and the agent's reply is spoken (Kokoro) while it streams; the mic reopens after playback, talking over a reply stops it. Spoken controls: pause, resume, stop listening.
